mode sparse.explanation: Configure the mode of PIM protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols igmp interface ge-1/0/0.explanation: This command enables IGMP (Internet Group Management Protocol) on a specified network interface (`[parameter1]`) for multicast group management.

set protocols pim join-filter cctv.explanation: The command `set protocols pim join-filter [parameter1]` configures a filter to control which multicast groups PIM (Protocol Independent Multicast) joins on the interface.

parameters.name: filter-name

prefix-list cctv.explanation: The command `prefix-list [parameter2]` creates or references a prefix list named `[parameter2]` for filtering IP prefixes in routing policies.

parameters.name: prefix-list

set protocols pim join-filter jstv.explanation: The command `set protocols pim join-filter [parameter1]` configures a filter to control which PIM (Protocol Independent Multicast) join messages are accepted or rejected.

parameters.name: filter-name

prefix-list jstv.explanation: The command `prefix-list [parameter2]` creates or references a prefix list named `[parameter2]` for filtering or matching IP prefixes in Junos routing policies.

parameters.name: prefix-list
parameters.explanation: The name of the prefix list, for example, jstv.

set firewall policer huawei-policer.explanation: The command `set firewall policer [parameter1]` creates or configures a firewall policer named `[parameter1]` to control traffic bandwidth and rate limits.

parameters.name: policer-name
parameters.explanation: The name of the policer, for example, huawei-policer.

if-exceeding bandwidth-limit 2m.explanation: The command sets a bandwidth limit threshold on an interface; if traffic exceeds the specified `[parameter2]` value, it triggers a predefined action.

if-exceeding burst-size-limit 250k.explanation: The command sets the maximum burst size limit for traffic exceeding a specified rate, where `[parameter2]` defines the burst size in bytes.

parameters.name: burst-size-limit
parameters.explanation: The burst size limit value, for example, 250k.

then discard.explanation: The command fragment `then [parameter2]` in Junos specifies the action to be taken in a policy or filter, such as `accept`, `reject`, or `next term`.

set firewall filter huawei-filter.explanation: The command `set firewall filter [parameter1]` creates or configures a firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS for traffic filtering and security policies.

parameters.name: filter-name
parameters.explanation: The name of the filter, for example, huawei-filter.

term huawei.explanation: The command `term [parameter2]` in Junos creates or references a specific term within a firewall filter or policy, defining matching conditions and actions for traffic.

parameters.name: term-name
parameters.explanation: The name of the condition, for example, huawei.

then policer huawei-policer.explanation: The command `then policer [parameter3]` applies a traffic policing policy to matching traffic, limiting the bandwidth to the rate specified by the policer `[parameter3]`.

parameters.name: policer-name
parameters.explanation: The name of the policer, for example, huawei-policer.
